summary: Iteration 3: Tested NEW features (receipt printing flow, CSV/PDF export, dashboard hourly chart) and re-verified core flows. Backend: 45/45 pytest pass (added 12 new tests in test_iter3_new_features.py covering hourly-sales 24-bucket structure, hourly aggregation reflecting new orders, order response shape for receipt rendering, cash/credit/discount receipts, CSV exports, and history export role guards). Frontend Playwright: dashboard hourly-sales-chart renders with real recharts SVG bars; POS cash order auto-opens ReceiptModal showing Subtotal/Tax/Total/CASH labels and print-receipt-btn; close-receipt-btn dismisses modal and reprint-receipt-btn becomes visible; credit order receipt shows CREDIT label; flat $1 discount applied → receipt shows discount amount; Reports page → Export CSV downloads sales_2026-04-25.csv via blob; Generate X Report → print-x-pdf-btn appears; Z Report tab Generate → export-z-csv-btn + print-z-pdf-btn appear; History tab — export-history-csv-btn is conditionally rendered only when history.length>0 (currently empty because Z report was already closed earlier in env).

issues: Reprint Last Receipt button at the very bottom of the right ticket panel can get visually clipped at 1080p when the ticket panel content is tall (logout footer overlaps). Cosmetic — button is still clickable.
When history is empty the empty state is shown but Export History CSV button is hidden; consider showing it disabled with a tooltip 'No history to export' for discoverability.

action_items: (Optional UX) In Reports History tab, render Export History CSV button as disabled when history is empty rather than hiding it entirely.
(Optional code review carry-over from iter 2) Backend trusts client-supplied subtotal/tax/total in /api/orders — recommend recomputing on server to prevent tampering.
(Optional code review carry-over) Add password length validation to /api/auth/register.
(Optional) Order endpoint deducts stock with max(0, stock-qty) without rejecting oversells.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:get_hourly_sales — correctly initialises 24 fixed buckets and aggregates by hour; iso parse wrapped in try/except so corrupted timestamps cannot 500. Looks good.

server.py:export_report_csv — returns rows but does not enforce admin-only; cashiers can export today's sales CSV. Consider role gating if business policy requires it (matches /api/reports/x which is also cashier-allowed, so likely intentional).
ReceiptModal print uses window.open + write of HTML and triggers print(); robust enough for thermal/POS printers. No backend coupling.
ReportsPage.printReportPDF generates an HTML window and prints — correct browser-based approach.
DashboardPage hourly chart Recharts BarChart receives data from /api/dashboard/hourly-sales; tooltip formatter renders cash/credit per hour correctly (verified visually).
Order response now consistently includes id, items, payment_type, subtotal, tax, total, discount_amount, cashier_name, created_at — sufficient for ReceiptModal.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, dashboard chart, POS cash/credit/discount + receipt modal + reprint, Reports CSV download + X/Z PDF buttons)

seed_data_creation: Test fixtures created TEST_Iter3Cat / TEST_Iter3Item and several TEST_iter3_* cashier accounts; menu_item + category cleaned in fixture teardown. Cashier accounts are persisted (acceptable for dev env).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v` (45 tests, ~6s, all pass). New iter3 features tests are in test_iter3_new_features.py. Frontend critical selectors: hourly-sales-chart, pos-item-{id}, pay-cash-btn, pay-credit-btn, print-receipt-btn, close-receipt-btn, reprint-receipt-btn (only after at least one order today), export-x-csv-btn (uses page.expect_download), generate-x-report-btn → print-x-pdf-btn appears after, tab-z-report + generate-z-report-btn → export-z-csv-btn + print-z-pdf-btn, tab-history + load-history-btn → export-history-csv-btn (only when history.length>0). When testing POS items, ALWAYS use page.wait_for_function on pos-item-* count > 0 because items load asynchronously after the pos-page mounts. Receipt modal auto-opens ~800ms after order POST success.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found in iteration 3. The previously reported 'failed to place order' on cash button could not be reproduced — backend /api/orders returns 200 with full receipt body in tests, and Playwright cash flow opens receipt modal as expected. The user-reported issue likely pre-dated iter 2's defensive ObjectId fix in /api/inventory which used to throw 500 and may have surfaced as a generic 'failed' toast on the POS page if any cross-call hit that endpoint.
